owner_gate: Do not wire until E026 Owner PASS and the endpoint contract is available.
principles: Adopt only the safe A026 view-model groups.
Keep current mutation endpoints and domain authorities unchanged.
Do not use A026 to source World, Quest, Shop, Premium, encounter, battle or reward state.
Keep a bounded legacy fallback while the new snapshot is unavailable.
Do not let local presentation caches become authority during fallback.

steps.scope: Read-only overview header/summary fragment only; do not migrate equipment controls or effect summary in the first slice.

retain: /api/player/appearance for character authority until snapshot adoption is proven

steps.fallback_behavior: If the pending presentation snapshot is absent, retain current server reads and render the existing neutral unavailable state; never promote hero_combat_gear_v1 into authority.
steps.rollback_path: Disable the surface adapter at the overview-fragment boundary and restore renderHeroOverview() to its existing source calls; no route or state mutation rollback is needed.
test_requirement: snapshot identity/xp/rank renders into existing Hero DOM
unknown/forbidden progression fields are not rendered
no combat bonus or premium state is inferred
hero_combat_gear_v1 cannot override server character identity
steps.reason_for_order: Contained read-only summary with direct A026 fit, but current helper mixes safe and unsafe fields; isolating the fragment limits risk.

steps.scope: Replace only the .home-player-card identity/progression/active-Spirit display; leave World map and Adventure state untouched.
steps.fallback_behavior: If snapshot load fails, preserve current loadPlayerAvatar() path for the identity card only; map bootstrap and shell paths continue independently.
steps.rollback_path: Restore the identity-card render helper while leaving World state and URL/history unchanged.
test_requirement: identity snapshot does not alter selectedZone
steps.reason_for_order: The identity fragment is safe, but index.html also owns World, Adventure and legacy shell initialization.

steps.scope: Adopt A026 only for owned/selected pure cosmetics in the seven supported appearance slots.

retire_for_safe_facts: profile.wardrobe reads used only for pure cosmetic owned/selected display after parity proof

steps.fallback_behavior: Keep current profile wardrobe projection if the new snapshot is unavailable; classify any item with gameplay effects through wardrobeHasGameplayEffect() and keep it in the functional Equipment projection.
steps.rollback_path: Turn off pure-cosmetic adapter at renderCosmeticProjection()/renderInvSlot() boundary; leave mutation endpoints and server selection unchanged.
test_requirement: owned/equipped parity for all seven supported slots
effect-bearing appearance never enters pure cosmetic view
steps.reason_for_order: Read-only visual state is adoptable, but the current broad wardrobe payload and effect-bearing split require fail-closed classification.

steps.scope: Adopt only the functional Equipment grid/detail read projection; do not migrate the general Backpack or actions.

retire_for_safe_facts: duplicated equipment display reads after snapshot parity is proven

steps.fallback_behavior: Keep current /api/player/inventory loader and detail/action behavior if the pending snapshot is unavailable; never synthesize ownership from shop catalog or local cache.
steps.rollback_path: Remove the equipment read adapter at the grid/detail boundary and return to loadFunctionalEquipment(); leave general Backpack untouched.
test_requirement: no combat stats are calculated in the adapter
equip/unequip continues to use current server endpoint
steps.reason_for_order: This surface has the largest number of separate authorities and write actions; it is safest after read-only identity/cosmetic adoption patterns are proven.

future_file_collision_map.reason: Inline render helpers, mutation wiring, local cache and effect-bearing split share one document.
Identity card shares a large Adventure/World/E9/E10 runtime and many separate authorities.
Functional Equipment and general Backpack are co-located but have different authorities and mutations.
A026 consumer contract input; no current frontend wiring exists.
E026 may propose a route, but A027 does not assume or modify it.
Served E9 compatibility components and adapters may remain fallback dependencies; they are not current identity source helpers in index.html.
